meta.name: release-skills
meta.description: Universal release workflow. Auto-detects version files and changelogs. Supports Node.js, Python, Rust, Claude Plugin, GitHub Releases, annotated tags, historical release backfill, and generic projects. Use when user says "release", "发布", "new version", "bump version", "push", "推送", "release notes", "GitHub Release", or "回填 Release".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动检测版本文件并生成发布流程
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果每次发布新版本都要手动改文件、写更新日志
copy.tagline_en: Automatically detect version files and generate release workflow
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manually update version files and changelogs for every release

howto.what: 它会自动识别项目的版本文件(如 package.json)与 changelog,分析上个 tag 以来的提交,判断版本号升降并生成多语言更新日志,按模块分别提交、打上 annotated tag,还可推送并创建 GitHub Release。
howto.when: 当你提到 “release”、“发布” 等词,或要求生成 release notes、回填 GitHub Release 时触发;也可直接运行 /release-skills。

say.note: 自动识别版本文件和 changelog,推荐版本号后请你确认

say.text: 用 --dry-run 预览这次发布要改什么
say.note: 只显示改动,不实际执行

howto.what_en: It auto-detects your version file and changelogs, reads commits since the last tag, picks the version bump, writes multi-language changelogs, commits per module, creates an annotated tag, and can push and publish a GitHub Release.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say "release", "发布" or "push", ask for release notes, or run /release-skills. It also backfills GitHub Releases for existing tags.

say_en.note: Auto-detects version file and changelogs, then asks you to confirm
Shows what would change without executing
Creates Releases for existing tags from changelog sections
